evidence: The leading liquid defined-ester carrier supports a lighter-distribution architecture; this is a qualitative load hypothesis, not measured evaporation or hair feel.
The reviewed declaration supplies no identified principal silicone conditioning-film, wax, gum or resin system that establishes a stronger retained-burden interpretation.
counter_signal: Argan, baobab and coconut are a retained botanical co-carrier route; exact coconut has a rich rough material prior, making medium plausible.
The ester is not assumed to evaporate. Both ester and botanicals can remain on hair, with unknown amounts and grades.
weight.reason: Nick accepted light/low as the source-scoped working estimate after reviewing the medium argument. Botanical retention and coconut presence alone do not establish that the oil system outweighs the lighter ester architecture under B4. This is a later human decision on the borderline case, not a claim that the frozen trial was unanimous.
unresolved: Relative carrier contributions, commercial grades, applied dose and deposited hair-film burden remain unmeasured.
The exact argan and baobab display names remain unmatched to material priors in this frozen reference; generic botanical role does not silently confer a species weight or alias.
Recorded literal function/preparation gaps from round-5 R06 remain visible; no unknown entry is assumed trace or harmless.

supersedes.scope: Current accepted product decision only; immutable prior artifact stays unchanged.
